dogecoin.text: It shows that current whales rely on bullish continuation as more and more Dogecoin approaches the key psychological level around $0.40.
Besides the rise of whales’ involvement in transactions, the daily trading volumes of Dogecoin have surged, which indicates higher certainty among retail and institutional buyers.
Experts assumed moving closer to critical points would allow the Dogecoin price to transcend upper barriers and reach the symbolic $1 mark.
